summary: As a Reviewer, I want to complete my assigned review task with the appropriate verdict and review context so that the document review is formally recorded and the workflow progresses

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Reviewer can log in to Veeva Vault QualityDocs using the Reviewer account credentials and is presented with the QualityDocs interface
After login, the Reviewer can navigate to the Home view
The Reviewer's most recently assigned workflow task is visible in the Home view
The Reviewer can open the assigned workflow task
The task completion form displays a Verdict field and a Review Context field
The Reviewer can select "Review Completed" from the Verdict field options
The Reviewer can select "Quality Review" from the Review Context field options
After completing and submitting the task, the task is marked as complete
The workflow advances: the document transitions from In Review to Review Completed, and the Quality Doc SME receives their final review task
If the Reviewer has multiple tasks in their Home view, they can identify the most recent one assigned by the workflow initiation (Alternative Path)
The Verdict field is mandatory; the system does not allow the task to be submitted without a verdict selection
The Review Context field is mandatory; the system does not allow the task to be submitted without a review context selection
Only the assigned Reviewer can complete this task; other users (including the Quality Doc SME) cannot submit this task on behalf of the Reviewer
The Reviewer must complete the task with Verdict "Review Completed" and Review Context "Quality Review" as specified in the workflow requirement (Business Rule)
Each workflow participant uses their own distinct session; the Reviewer session is separate from the SME session (Business Rule)
Role-based access control is enforced: the Reviewer role can only perform the review task; they cannot initiate or finalize the workflow (Business Rule)

HP.description: Reviewer logs in, navigates to Home, opens assigned task, selects Verdict="Review Completed" and Review Context="Quality Review", submits task, verifies task complete and document state="Review Completed" and SME receives final task

AP.description: Reviewer has multiple tasks in Home view and identifies the most recent one assigned by CS-8 workflow

NEG.description: Non-assigned user (e.g., Quality Doc SME) attempts to complete the Reviewer's task — expected result: access denied or submit disabled
Reviewer with Reviewer role attempts to initiate or finalize workflow (actions outside role scope) — expected result: unauthorized action prevented

ERR.description: Missing Verdict field — Reviewer attempts to submit task without selecting a Verdict — expected result: validation error "Verdict is required"
Missing Review Context field — Reviewer attempts to submit task without selecting a Review Context — expected result: validation error "Review Context is required"

INT.description: Verify end-to-end workflow from CS-8 completion (SME initiates) to CS-9 completion (Reviewer completes) — validate task assignment chain and state transitions
